# VivaAge

> VivaAge is a Vietnamese educational PWA that helps adults aged 40+ prepare for healthy aging with a readiness assessment, a 30-day plan, a library, a motivational blog, and grounded Q&A with sources.

VivaAge provides education and planning tools only. It does not diagnose disease, prescribe medicine, or replace clinicians, financial advisors, or lawyers. Primary language: Vietnamese (vi-VN). Tagline: Chuẩn bị hôm nay, tự chủ về sau (“Prepare today, stay independent later”).

## Docs

- [OpenAPI](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/openapi.json): Machine-readable public HTTP API description
- [API catalog](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset for automated API discovery
- [auth.md](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/auth.md): How agents authenticate with anonymous sessions
- [Agent skills index](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Discoverable skills with SHA-256 digests
- [MCP server card](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol entrypoint
- [AI catalog](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD capability manifest (MCP, OpenAPI, skills, API catalog)
- [Sitemap](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/sitemap.xml): Crawlable product, library, and blog URLs
- [llms-full.txt](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/llms-full.txt): Expanded link list for larger context windows

## Product

- [Home](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/): Brand story, pillars, FAQ, and primary CTAs
- [Readiness assessment](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/danh-gia): About 7 minutes; health, finance, and caregiving readiness
- [30-day plan](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/ke-hoach): Small weekly actions based on assessment gaps
- [Ask VivaAge](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/hoi): Educational Q&A with citations when sources exist
- [Library](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien): Short lessons on midlife health, money, and caregiving
- [Today](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/hom-nay): Progress and next small actions after onboarding

## Optional

- [Motivational blog](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/blog): Daily encouragement posts for adults 40+
- [Profile & privacy](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/ho-so): Session, privacy, and disclaimer notes
- [robots.txt](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/robots.txt): Crawl rules and Content Signals
- [Atom feed](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/feed.xml): Published blog posts for feed readers and agents
